newsitem.title: USA: Venezuela stability based on reform, not oil - Casas.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela stability based on reform, not oil - Casas.

text.p: Antonio Casas, president of Venezuela's Central Bank said on Friday oil prices had helped his country's economic recovery, but macroeconomic reform is the backbone of stabilization.
"Oil prices are helping (the Venezuelan economy), but they are not going to solve our problems in the medium and long run," Casas said after a conference here.

"If prices fall, we will be a little bit more restrictive," Casas added. The Venezuelan central banker said that his country's economic reform program which began in April laid the foundation for stabilization.
"As long as we have the right policies, no matter how much oil prices fall, we will still have (resources) to back us up and stabilize the economy," Casas said.
